backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend, defining product/user/session data types, access control, product CRUD operations, and Amazon product metadata extraction via HTTP outcalls with priority-based HTML parsing.
feature_evidence.json: A feature evidence report mapping implemented frontend performance features (WebP images, Vite minification, critical CSS inlining, explicit image dimensions) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of components, hooks, and styles.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN settings (minification, Brotli, caching, image optimization, HTTP/3) to improve performance of the RecomNow India website.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Documents a production deployment failure caused by a missing favicon asset and provides a comprehensive go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, service worker, and functionality checks.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, geo tags, structured data for the organization, resource preloads for critical assets, and inlined critical CSS to eliminate render-blocking.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: A phased performance optimization plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop, listing current issues and actionable steps including Cloudflare configuration, image optimization, and bundle splitting.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Documents all performance optimizations implemented for the RecomNow India frontend, covering critical CSS inlining, image optimization, code splitting, service worker caching, Core Web Vitals monitoring, and React Query tuning to achieve PageSpeed scores >85.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Standard robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to the sitemap URL.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with a single entry for the homepage, set to daily change frequency and priority 1.0.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first for static assets and network-first for HTML/API calls, with versioned caches, pre-caching of critical assets on install, and cleanup of old caches on activate.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles client-side routing via history API, lazily loads ProductsPage, AdminPage, and SitemapPage, and conditionally renders the Header, Footer, and PageModal.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder admin panel component that displays a notice indicating blog management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder admin panel component that displays a notice indicating newsletter management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin UI for full CRUD management of products, supporting add, edit, and delete operations with category selection, form state, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder admin panel component that displays a notice indicating site pages management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login component supporting both custom username/password authentication and Internet Identity login, with password strength validation, registration mode, and query cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard component with a top bar showing the logged-in user and logout button, and tabbed content for managing Products, Blog, Newsletter, and Site Pages.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Stub component that renders nothing; the Amazon banner feature has been removed.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Dialog component that displays a placeholder message indicating blog functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that previously showed blog teasers but now returns null as blog functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Memoized footer component with newsletter signup form, quick navigation links, social media icons, and trust badges, supporting both SPA navigation and page modal opening.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Memoized sticky header with logo, site title, and navigation links for Home, Products, and Admin Panel, using SPA-style client-side routing.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Memoized hero section with a priority-loaded background image, headline, CTA buttons that scroll to the products section, and trust badges.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Image component optimized for Core Web Vitals that renders a `<picture>` element with WebP source and PNG/JPEG fallback, supporting lazy/eager loading, fetchpriority, and CLS-preventing aspect-ratio styles.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component that displays static content pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Contact) based on a `pageKey` prop, with a scrollable body and close button.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Displays a color-coded strength bar and feedback list for a given password string using the `validatePasswordStrength` utility.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Paginated product grid with category filtering that fetches products via a query hook, renders product cards with images and pricing, and links out to Amazon affiliate URLs.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Displays a customer testimonials grid and an auto-rotating 'Recently Bought' ticker using hardcoded data for social proof on the storefront.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: A simple animated SVG spinner component used as a loading indicator throughout the app.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Renders a configurable set of trust badge images (e.g., Amazon Associates, SSL Secure, Money Back) in horizontal or vertical layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence for managing a custom username/password session token, including expiry validation and session lifecycle methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: React Query mutation hooks for user registration, login, and logout against the ICP backend actor, integrating with the Zustand auth store.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides two utility hooks: one for debouncing a value and one for debouncing a callback function, both with configurable delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating products, checking admin status, and retrieving user profiles via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS with custom CSS variables for a gold-and-navy light/dark color scheme and minor utility/component overrides.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript ambient module declaration providing type definitions for the web-vitals library's metric interface and reporting functions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that conditionally renders a login form, loading spinner, access-denied message, or the admin panel based on Internet Identity and custom session authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Simple page component that renders a header banner and the ProductGrid component for browsing all products.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Page component that generates and writes a basic XML sitemap directly to the document on mount, then renders nothing.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility that defers injection of third-party scripts (Google Analytics) until 3 seconds after the window load event to improve Core Web Vitals.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Provides functions to validate password strength (weak/medium/strong) based on length and character rules, and to check password confirmation matching.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and hash cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color palettes (gold, navy, sidebar, chart colors), border radius, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for a React/ICP frontend with aggressive Terser JS minification, LightningCSS minification, manual chunk splitting for vendor libraries, and a proxy to the local DFX network.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of a website performance optimization project targeting Google PageSpeed 90+, listing completed and planned features covering image optimization, minification, CLS fixes, script deferral, and font improvements.
